changes: scripts/accept-management-hosted-production.mjs: change default SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS from 4_000 to 15_000 (matching CONTENT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000 in scripts/probe-route-load-baseline.mjs) while preserving process.env.PANTHEON_ACCEPT_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS override.

.github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml: in step 'Management hosted production acceptance' (id: mgmt_hosted_accept), raise timeout-minutes from 8 to 15 and PANTHEON_ACCEPT_SETTLE_TIMEOUT_MS from 6000 to 20000.
